On the preferred dates, three changeable business seats cost $3,150 more in total than three changeable coach seats on the same flight. Either total works within the vacation plan, although the lower fare would leave more room for activities. A daytime one-stop has cheaper business seats, and another nonstop has coach seats but lands late the next evening. Which itinerary should be presented first?
